credential_policy: Settings UI credentials are process-memory only. Environment and ignored LocalConfig credentials remain supported for development.
fallback_policy: Transport errors, timeout, malformed JSON, schema mismatch, ungrounded assertions, forbidden knowledge, invalid proposals, stale state, or unsafe memory summaries immediately use one state-aware local fallback without another model call.
notes: Each player input makes at most one model call. The model receives only the active NPC profile, subjective state, filtered Top-K knowledge, safe memory, and a local action proposal whitelist. Rules, state mutation, disclosure upgrades, and proposal execution remain local and deterministic.
